name: Speak with Un'thuwa
summary: Un'thuwa, Sen'jin Village's tribal mage, senses a disturbance in Durotar's magic currents and asks you to speak with him. He hopes your aid will help him understand it.

sections.title: A Call for Aid
sections.body: In Sen'jin Village, Un'thuwa asks you to speak with him. The tribal mage senses a disturbance in Durotar's magic currents and seeks help. What he can learn may depend on your aid.

faq.answer: Un'thuwa is the tribal mage of Sen'jin Village.
Un'thuwa detects a disturbance in Durotar's magic currents.

faq.q: Why does Un'thuwa want to speak with me?
faq.answer: Un'thuwa asks for your aid with the disturbance he senses in Durotar's magic currents.

faq.q: What might come from helping Un'thuwa?
faq.answer: Un'thuwa says that further secrets may be revealed to you in time.

angles.text: As a mage, you are asked to speak with Un'thuwa, the tribal mage who senses a disturbance in Durotar's magic currents.

attribution: In-game quest text: Speak with Un'thuwa
